# KPI dictionary

<!-- Generated by src/docs.py from data/reference/kpi_catalog.csv, data/reference/plan_targets.csv and the warehouse. Edit the source and rerun the pipeline, not this file. -->

The 22 KPIs Kelip Bank reports each month: what each one means, how it is calculated, who owns it, which way is good, and where it comes from. The six marked as scorecard KPIs have a monthly plan and a red, amber or green status; the rest have a single target. Each KPI answers at least one question in the [business requirements](01_business_requirements.md). Latest values are for August 2026. All data is synthetic.

## Growth

<a id="k01"></a>

### K01 Applications started

Applicants who started sign-up in the app in the month.

- **Formula:** count of applicants whose signup_started event falls in the month (Malaysia time)
- **Owner:** Head of Onboarding
- **Unit:** Count
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** 3,000 (FY2026 monthly average)
- **Source:** `kpi.growth_monthly.applications_started`
- **Answers:** Q06, Q07
- **Dashboard page:** Growth
- **Latest:** 3,639 in August 2026

<a id="k02"></a>

### K02 New customers

Accounts opened in the month.

- **Formula:** count of customers by the month their account opened
- **Owner:** Head of Growth
- **Unit:** Count
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** Monthly plan, 800 to 1,950 over 24 months; 1,950 for August 2026 (FY plan)
- **Source:** `kpi.growth_monthly.new_customers`
- **Answers:** Q01, Q06
- **Dashboard page:** Executive, Growth
- **Latest:** 1,972 in August 2026, On plan

<a id="k05"></a>

### K05 Cost per new customer (CAC)

Acquisition marketing spend per account opened.

- **Formula:** acquisition spend / new customers; blank while an invoice is missing
- **Owner:** Head of Growth
- **Unit:** Ringgit (RM)
- **Better when:** lower
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** RM25.00 (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.growth_monthly.cac`
- **Answers:** Q05, Q24
- **Dashboard page:** Growth
- **Latest:** RM21.63 in July 2026

<a id="k06"></a>

### K06 Month-3 active rate

Share of customers who opened three months earlier and made a transaction themselves this month.

- **Formula:** customers active in their third month after opening / customers in that cohort
- **Owner:** Head of Growth
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** 65.0% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.growth_monthly.m3_active_rate`
- **Answers:** Q04, Q05, Q11
- **Dashboard page:** Growth, Engagement
- **Latest:** 61.9% in August 2026

## Onboarding

<a id="k03"></a>

### K03 Onboarding conversion

Share of the month's applicants who went on to open an account.

- **Formula:** applicants who reached account_opened / applicants who started, by start month
- **Owner:** Head of Onboarding
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** 55.0% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.growth_monthly.onboarding_conversion`
- **Answers:** Q07, Q08
- **Dashboard page:** Growth
- **Latest:** 53.8% in August 2026

<a id="k04"></a>

### K04 eKYC completion rate

Share of applicants who scanned their MyKad and then passed the selfie liveness check.

- **Formula:** liveness passed / MyKad scanned, by start month
- **Owner:** Head of Onboarding
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** 75.0% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.growth_monthly.ekyc_completion_rate`
- **Answers:** Q07, Q08
- **Dashboard page:** Growth
- **Latest:** 77.4% in August 2026

## Engagement

<a id="k07"></a>

### K07 Monthly active customers

Customers who made at least one transaction themselves in the month.

- **Formula:** count of customers with a transfer out, bill payment, card purchase or FD placement
- **Owner:** Head of Product
- **Unit:** Count
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** Monthly plan, 700 to 18,000 over 24 months; 18,000 for August 2026 (FY plan)
- **Source:** `kpi.engagement_monthly.monthly_active_customers`
- **Answers:** Q01, Q10
- **Dashboard page:** Executive, Engagement
- **Latest:** 18,522 in August 2026, On plan

<a id="k08"></a>

### K08 Active customer rate

Share of customers with an open account who were active in the month.

- **Formula:** monthly active customers / customers with an open account at month end
- **Owner:** Head of Product
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** 65.0% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.engagement_monthly.active_customer_rate`
- **Answers:** Q10
- **Dashboard page:** Engagement
- **Latest:** 60.2% in August 2026

<a id="k09"></a>

### K09 Transactions per active customer

Transactions active customers made themselves, per customer.

- **Formula:** customer-initiated transactions / monthly active customers
- **Owner:** Head of Product
- **Unit:** Number
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** 9.0 (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.engagement_monthly.txns_per_active_customer`
- **Answers:** Q10, Q12
- **Dashboard page:** Engagement
- **Latest:** 10.3 in August 2026

## Cards

<a id="k10"></a>

### K10 Card activation within 30 days

Share of the month's new customers with a debit card who activated it within 30 days of opening.

- **Formula:** cards activated within 30 days / new customers issued a card
- **Owner:** Head of Cards
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** 65.0% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.cards_monthly.card_activation_30d`
- **Answers:** Q11, Q17
- **Dashboard page:** Engagement
- **Latest:** 58.3% in July 2026

<a id="k11"></a>

### K11 Debit card spend

Card purchases settled and posted to the ledger in the month.

- **Formula:** sum of card purchase postings (RM)
- **Owner:** Head of Cards
- **Unit:** Ringgit (RM)
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** RM15.0m (FY2026 monthly average)
- **Source:** `kpi.cards_monthly.card_spend`
- **Answers:** Q16
- **Dashboard page:** Engagement
- **Latest:** RM16.9m in August 2026

<a id="k12"></a>

### K12 Card approval rate

Share of card authorisation attempts approved.

- **Formula:** approved authorisations (response 00) / all authorisations
- **Owner:** Head of Cards
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 1% of plan or target
- **Target:** 95.0% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.cards_monthly.card_approval_rate`
- **Answers:** Q18
- **Dashboard page:** Engagement
- **Latest:** 95.3% in August 2026

## Deposits

<a id="k13"></a>

### K13 Total deposits

Savings (CASA) and fixed deposit balances at month end.

- **Formula:** sum of month-end deposit balances (RM)
- **Owner:** Treasurer
- **Unit:** Ringgit (RM)
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** Monthly plan, RM2.5m to RM115.0m over 24 months; RM115.0m for August 2026 (FY plan)
- **Source:** `kpi.deposits_monthly.total_deposits`
- **Answers:** Q01, Q13
- **Dashboard page:** Executive, Deposits
- **Latest:** RM132.2m in August 2026, On plan

<a id="k14"></a>

### K14 CASA ratio

Share of deposits held in current and savings accounts rather than fixed deposits.

- **Formula:** CASA balance / total deposits at month end
- **Owner:** Treasurer
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** Monthly plan, 80.0% to 90.0% over 24 months; 80.0% for August 2026 (FY2024 launch plan 90%, then 80%)
- **Source:** `kpi.deposits_monthly.casa_ratio`
- **Answers:** Q01, Q13, Q14
- **Dashboard page:** Executive, Deposits
- **Latest:** 78.2% in August 2026, Watch

<a id="k15"></a>

### K15 Cost of funds

Annualised interest cost of deposits.

- **Formula:** interest accrued on average balances / average deposits x 365 / days in month
- **Owner:** Treasurer
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** lower
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** Monthly plan, 2.00% to 2.20% over 24 months; 2.00% for August 2026 (Re-planned to 2.00% after the 9 Jul 2025 OPR cut)
- **Source:** `kpi.deposits_monthly.cost_of_funds`
- **Answers:** Q03, Q14, Q23
- **Dashboard page:** Executive, Deposits
- **Latest:** 1.94% in August 2026, On plan

<a id="k16"></a>

### K16 FD retention at maturity

Share of matured fixed deposit money still with the bank 30 days after maturity.

- **Formula:** (money rolled over + money paid to savings and not transferred out within 30 days) / money matured, by maturity month
- **Owner:** Treasurer
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 5% of plan or target
- **Target:** 75.0% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.fd_maturity_outcomes` (retained_30d / matured_amount)
- **Answers:** Q15
- **Dashboard page:** Deposits
- **Latest:** 83.8% in August 2026

## Credit

<a id="k17"></a>

### K17 Gross loans

Personal financing principal outstanding at month end.

- **Formula:** sum of outstanding principal on active loans (RM)
- **Owner:** Head of Credit Risk
- **Unit:** Ringgit (RM)
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** RM45.0m (By Aug 2026)
- **Source:** `kpi.credit_monthly.gross_loans`
- **Answers:** Q19
- **Dashboard page:** Credit
- **Latest:** RM49.1m in August 2026

<a id="k18"></a>

### K18 Financing disbursed

Personal financing paid out in the month.

- **Formula:** sum of principal disbursed (RM)
- **Owner:** Head of Credit Risk
- **Unit:** Ringgit (RM)
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** RM3.0m (FY2026 monthly average)
- **Source:** `kpi.credit_monthly.amount_disbursed`
- **Answers:** Q19
- **Dashboard page:** Credit
- **Latest:** RM3.2m in August 2026

<a id="k19"></a>

### K19 PAR30

Share of the loan book 30 or more days past due.

- **Formula:** outstanding principal on loans 30+ days past due / gross loans
- **Owner:** Head of Credit Risk
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** lower
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** Monthly plan, 2.50% to 3.00% over 20 months; 3.00% for August 2026 (No financing before Jan 2025; FY2025 2.5%, FY2026 3.0%)
- **Source:** `kpi.credit_monthly.par30`
- **Answers:** Q01, Q20, Q21
- **Dashboard page:** Executive, Credit
- **Latest:** 2.99% in August 2026, On plan

<a id="k20"></a>

### K20 Gross impaired loans (GIL) ratio

Share of the loan book impaired, meaning more than 90 days past due.

- **Formula:** outstanding principal on loans more than 90 days past due / gross loans
- **Owner:** Head of Credit Risk
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** lower
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** 2.00% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.credit_monthly.gil_ratio`
- **Answers:** Q21
- **Dashboard page:** Credit
- **Latest:** 1.26% in August 2026

<a id="k21"></a>

### K21 Early delinquency at month 6

Share of the loans disbursed six months earlier that have ever been 30+ days past due.

- **Formula:** loans ever 30+ days past due by month on book 6 / loans in that vintage
- **Owner:** Head of Credit Risk
- **Unit:** Percentage
- **Better when:** lower
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** 5.00% (nan)
- **Source:** `kpi.credit_monthly.early_delinquency_mob6`
- **Answers:** Q19, Q20
- **Dashboard page:** Credit
- **Latest:** 3.80% in August 2026

## Finance

<a id="k22"></a>

### K22 Net interest income

Interest earned on performing financing less interest accrued on deposits.

- **Formula:** loan interest income - deposit interest expense (RM, accrual basis)
- **Owner:** CFO
- **Unit:** Ringgit (RM)
- **Better when:** higher
- **Amber band:** 10% of plan or target
- **Target:** RM200,000 (FY2026 monthly average)
- **Source:** `kpi.finance_monthly.net_interest_income`
- **Answers:** Q03, Q23
- **Dashboard page:** Executive
- **Latest:** RM182,302 in August 2026
